title: Use API route as OAuth callback to route new vs. existing users
body:
Instead of landing all OAuth completions on `/`, the `callbackURL` now points to a dedicated API route that inspects the session and redirects appropriately.

## Changes

- **`/api/auth/callback` (new)** — POST-OAuth redirect target; sends new users (`needsUsername === true`) to `/setup-username`, existing users to `/`
- **`/api/auth/signin/github`** — `callbackURL` changed from `"/"` to `"/api/auth/callback"`

## Flow

```
GitHub OAuth → better-auth callback → GET /api/auth/callback
                                          ├─ needsUsername → /setup-username
                                          └─ existing user → /
```

Previously, `index.tsx` handled the new-user redirect via a `route.load` check. That logic is now centralised in the API layer, and the page-level check on `/` remains as a safety net.
